record.original_question: For the quadratic polynomial P_c(z) = z^2 + c with connected Julia set, is the Julia set locally connected whenever the parameter c is real?

evidence.quote: Let Pc (z) = z 2 + c where c ranges over values for which the Julia set of Pc is connected.
Question 9. Is the Julia set of Pc locally connected when c is real?

artifact.self_contained_problem: For a complex parameter $c \in \mathbb{C}$, let $P_c : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ be the quadratic polynomial $P_c(z) = z^2 + c$. The filled Julia set $K(P_c)$ is the set of points $z \in \mathbb{C}$ whose forward orbit $\{P_c^n(z)\}_{n \ge 0}$ is bounded, and the Julia set $J(P_c) = \partial K(P_c)$ is its topological boundary. Restrict attention to those parameters $c$ for which $J(P_c)$ is connected (equivalently, the critical orbit of $0$ under $P_c$ is bounded).\n\nProve or disprove: for every real parameter $c \in \mathbb{R}$ such that $J(P_c)$ is connected, the Julia set $J(P_c)$ is locally connected.
artifact.status_search_result: The question was answered affirmatively. Levin and van Strien (Annals of Mathematics, 1998) proved that the Julia set of a real polynomial with only real critical points is locally connected whenever it is connected; in particular, $J(P_c)$ is locally connected for every real $c$ in the Mandelbrot set. Independent proofs in the quadratic case were also obtained via complex bounds (Lyubich, Graczyk–Świątek).

status_evidence.title: Local connectivity of the Julia set of real polynomials (Levin–van Strien)
status_evidence.snippet: Levin and van Strien proved local connectivity of Julia sets of real polynomials with only real critical points, in particular for real quadratic polynomials with connected Julia set.
status_evidence.claim: Real quadratic Julia sets (when connected) are locally connected.

status_evidence.title: Dynamics of quadratic polynomials, I–II (Lyubich)
status_evidence.snippet: Lyubich established complex bounds and local connectivity results for real quadratic polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: Independent confirmation of local connectivity for real quadratic Julia sets.
